events.title: Black Prince defeats Henry of Trastámara at Nájera
events.description: Edward the Black Prince routed the Castilian and French army of Henry of Trastámara at Nájera, restoring Peter of Castile. The victory proved short-lived: Henry killed Peter and took the throne two years later.
events.html: Edward the Black Prince routed the Castilian and French army of Henry of Trastámara at Nájera, restoring Peter of Castile. The victory proved short-lived: Henry killed Peter and took the throne two years later.

events.title: Peace of Cateau-Cambrésis ends the Italian Wars
events.description: France and Spain signed the treaty that closed more than sixty years of war over Italy, a day after a separate Anglo-French peace. Spanish dominance in Italy was confirmed for over a century.
events.html: France and Spain signed the treaty that closed more than sixty years of war over Italy, a day after a separate Anglo-French peace. Spanish dominance in Italy was confirmed for over a century.

events.title: Sweden signs a treaty of amity with the United States
events.description: Benjamin Franklin and the Swedish envoy Gustaf Philip Creutz signed a treaty of amity and commerce in Paris. Sweden became the first state not at war with Britain to recognise American independence by treaty.
events.html: Benjamin Franklin and the Swedish envoy Gustaf Philip Creutz signed a treaty of amity and commerce in Paris. Sweden became the first state not at war with Britain to recognise American independence by treaty.

events.title: Pony Express sets off on its first run
events.description: Riders left St Joseph, Missouri, and Sacramento, California, carrying mail across some 3,000 km in about ten days. The relay lasted only 18 months before the transcontinental telegraph made it obsolete.
events.html: Riders left St Joseph, Missouri, and Sacramento, California, carrying mail across some 3,000 km in about ten days. The relay lasted only 18 months before the transcontinental telegraph made it obsolete.

events.title: Robert Ford shoots outlaw Jesse James in Missouri
events.description: Jesse James was shot dead at his home in St Joseph by Robert Ford, a member of his own gang hoping for a reward. The killing turned the train and bank robber into an enduring figure of American folklore.
events.html: Jesse James was shot dead at his home in St Joseph by Robert Ford, a member of his own gang hoping for a reward. The killing turned the train and bank robber into an enduring figure of American folklore.

events.title: British biplanes make the first flight over Everest
events.description: Two Westland aircraft of the Houston expedition flew over the summit of Mount Everest, crews breathing bottled oxygen in open cockpits. They brought back the first aerial photographs of the peak.
events.html: Two Westland aircraft of the Houston expedition flew over the summit of Mount Everest, crews breathing bottled oxygen in open cockpits. They brought back the first aerial photographs of the peak.

events.title: Martin Luther King gives his 'Mountaintop' speech
events.description: In Memphis, Martin Luther King Jr. told supporters he had 'seen the Promised Land' but might not get there with them. It was his last speech; he was assassinated the following evening.
